name: abl_attn_pool
description: Stage-(b) of Phase-4 plan (PLAN.md §13.2). Replaces ESM2 mean-pool with a learned single-head attention-pool over per-residue embeddings. All other components (balanced sampler, margin loss, hard-neg mining, bilinear head rank=128) stay at v4 default. Tag runs v5_attnpool.

model.head: bilinear
model.capacity_note: Adds a ResidueAttentionPool: 1 learned query [1280] + LayerNorm[1280] = ~3.8k params on top of v4 default (627k). Negligible parameter delta — this is a representational change, not a capacity change.
